headline: Castrol India Limited: Public Announcement-Open Offer
sum: Public Announcement-Open Offer - UBS Securities India Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of detailed public statement in terms of Regulations 3(1), 4 and 5(1) read with Regulations 13(4), 14(3) and 15(2) and other…
detail: Public Announcement-Open Offer - UBS Securities India Private Limited has Submitted to the Exchange a copy of detailed public statement in terms of Regulations 3(1), 4 and 5(1) read with Regulations 13(4), 14(3) and 15(2) and other applicable Regulations to stock Exchange in respect of any acquisition made in reliance upon exemption provided for in regulation 10 of SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011, as amended. to the public shareholders of the Castrol India Limited (Target Company).
